Hi {{lead.First Name:default=Friend}},
Thank you for attending our “The FX factor: Why cross-border payments can make or break your customer experience" webinar.
We hope you enjoyed learning from Flywire's Chris McCracken and Talent.com’s Maxime Laliberte to hear advice and best practices from the industry.
Watch the recording here! <[[https://www.flywire.com/resources/webinar-recording-the-fx-factor-why-cross-border-payments-can-make-or-break-your-customer-experience]]>
In addition to the survey, be sure to check out our case study with Talent.com <[[https://www.flywire.com/resources/case-study-talent-com-implements-flywire-to-drive-global-growth]]> and the full payer report <[[https://flywire.foleon.com/report/b2b-payments-survey-2024/]]>.
Need more information or have questions? Please reach out to Chris McCracken: chris.mccracken@flywire.com.
Thank you!
The Flywire Team Flywire Global Headquarters 141 Tremont Street, Boston, MA 02111 United States
